title: Discover current recorded changes without selecting authority
description: Inspect bounded project-local locations and classify current change candidates using the declared structural rules. Return placement and selection facts, never a next activity, archival judgment, implicit change selection, or recovery action.
inputs: Project context and validated placement configuration.
An optional explicit change selection or a bounded discovery request.
outputs: Explicit selection, safe configured locations, coherent current candidate identities/contracts/revisions, and classification counts.
Scope/completeness and safe diagnostics for malformed, ambiguous, interrupted, unsupported, or inaccessible input.
behavior: Apply current/archive classification without operationally interpreting historical lifecycle data or deriving registry authority from arbitrary files.
Distinguish coherent v3, bounded recognized archives, both-manifest ambiguity, unknown headers, reserved current residue, interrupted transaction attention, unrelated directories, and absence.
Honor an explicit selection without enumerating unrelated candidates; otherwise inspect only the bounded declared discovery scope and order returned candidates deterministically.
Report each candidate's observed revision and contract as factual context requiring fresh checks before mutation, not an atomic cross-change snapshot.
Keep configuration provenance and path-placement facts separate from writable authority and reject retired spec/unknown configuration kinds before discovery.

failure_behavior.condition: A current candidate is malformed, mixed, ambiguous, unsafe, or interrupted.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the applicable explicit diagnostic and incomplete scope rather than silently excluding it as archived.

failure_behavior.condition: Enumeration, candidate-count, or result bounds prevent complete discovery.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the bounded failure with complete=false rather than truncate silently or choose the first candidate.

sources.basis: Functional Analysis of the IR-008 system obligations confirms this distinct published command/record responsibility. The retained CLI/Record Format contract supplies exact public operations and limits; logical behavior is defined before Module allocation.
